What stopped users

  • blocking

    The 'Choose a date' button, all calendar date buttons, seats +/- buttons, and 'Reserve' button are not in the keyboard Tab order. Tab jumps from the breadcrumb directly to the footer, skipping the entire booking form. Keyboard-only users cannot select a date, change seat count, or proceed to checkout.

    Keyboard only · Workshop detail page – booking panel (right side) and calendar (left side)
  • blocking

    Could not find the 'Continue' or 'Book' button after selecting a date from the December 2026 calendar. The date selection appeared to work (gray border appeared on selected date) but no obvious next-step button was visible below the calendar or in the page. The peach-colored section below the calendar turned out to be a decorative illustration, not a button.

    Low vision · Workshop detail page - calendar section
  • major

    The 'Available' and 'Sold out' legend dots use very similar gold/olive tones that are hard to distinguish with deuteranopia — I could not reliably tell which dates were available vs sold out at a glance.

    Colour blindness · Date picker calendar (workshop page)
  • major

    Dec 1, 2, and 5 all showed as 'Available' on the calendar but were actually full — booking 2 seats put me on a waitlist (€0.00) at checkout. No indication of how many seats remain per date, so I had to try 4 dates before finding one that actually worked.

    Colour blindness · Date picker calendar (workshop page)
  • major

    At 200% zoom with blurry vision, the calendar date cells were very small and hard to click accurately. Multiple clicks landed on wrong dates (hit '17' and '10' instead of intended '8'). The first available date (Dec 8) was never successfully selected.

    Low vision · Calendar date cells

Fixes, before and after

  • WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color Say which dates are sold out in words, not only in red and greenIn poc/demo_startup/server.py date_strip(), render the status as text inside each chip, e.g. <span class="day-num">10</span><span class="day-status">Open</span> or ..."Sold out", give each chip an accessible name such as aria-label="Thu 10 Dec, seats available", and render the legend as words with a striped swatch. In lune.css add a stripe pattern and line-through for .day.is-full so the state never depends on hue alone. Better still: disable sold-out dates or label them 'Waitlist'.
  • WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard Make the date chips and 'Reserve' real buttons, with a visible focus ringIn server.py date_strip(), render each bookable date as <button type="button" class="day ..." data-date=... aria-pressed="false"> instead of <div onclick>, and in workshop_page() replace <div class="reserve-cta" onclick="reserve()"> with <button type="submit" class="reserve-cta">. In booking.js, attach the click handler with addEventListener, keep a roving tabindex on the date group with arrow-key navigation, and validate the date in a submit listener. In lune.css, delete `*:focus { outline: none }` and add `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1b4dd8; outline-offset: 2px }`. Give the seat stepper buttons visible focus and space between them (gap: 8px, at least 30 px each), so a keyboard user can tell which one is focused.
  • WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow Let the booking page reflow at 200% zoomIn lune.css replace `.booking-shell { width: 1240px }` with `max-width: 1240px; width: 100%`, remove `overflow-x: hidden` from html.page-booking/body and `overflow-x: clip` from .clip, and add a breakpoint (max-width: 1000px) that switches .booking-shell to a single column with grid-template-areas placing the booking card after the date section, `position: static` for the card, and a wrapping date strip.
  • WCAG 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) Give the checkout total readable contrast and sizeIn lune.css set `.price-details { color: #3f3a34; font-size: 15px }` and `.price-details .price-total { color: #1d1a16; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700 }`.
